svg.title: Eleven idle cores: compiling text-2.1.4 with GHC and AIHC
svg.desc: GHC 9.12.4 compiles 54 modules one at a time in 28.0 seconds. AIHC runs them across 12 workers in 3.2 seconds, 8.8 times less wall-clock, both at -O0.

g.text: Apple M4 Pro · both at -O0 · measured traces, medians of 5 runs
Typed by robots, designed by a human.

svg.text: less wall-clock for the same 54 modules
